definitions.explanation: All human beings collectively. Used to discuss humans as a species or civilization as a whole.

examples.japanese: {人類|じんるい}の{歴史|れきし}は{長|なが}いです。
{環境|かんきょう}{問題|もんだい}は{人類|じんるい}{全体|ぜんたい}の{課題|かだい}です。
examples.english: Environmental issues are challenges for all of humanity.

examples.japanese: {人類|じんるい}は{月|つき}に{行|い}きました。

notes:
{人類|じんるい} refers to humanity as a whole.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {人類|じんるい}の{歴史|れきし} (human history)
- {人類|じんるい}の{未来|みらい} (humanity's future)
- {人類|じんるい}{全体|ぜんたい} (all of humanity)
- {人類|じんるい}にとって (for humanity)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {人間|にんげん}: human being (individual or collective)
- {人類|じんるい}: humanity (species/collective)
- {人々|ひとびと}: people (general group)
